steps.what: Review the valuation workpapers and locate relevant supporting evidence
Prepare existing testimony notes explaining the value and its limitations
Testify in court and respond to questions about the property value

tasks.design: Use a native workpaper index and existing testimony-note headings in {DOCS}. The appraiser personally prepares the explanation and testifies, retaining all evidential judgement and live answers.
tasks.previous_blocker: Locating supporting workpapers and repeating preparation-note structure consumes time.
tasks.enabler_now: Native views and fixed note headings can remove those mechanical operations without drafting legal claims.
tasks.still_hard: Questions may challenge comparability, assumptions or the meaning of the value conclusion.
tasks.human_edge: Explain the actual work accurately and acknowledge its limitations under questioning.
tasks.altitude: Reduce preparation handling while preserving personal testimony.

reach.task: Clarify the questions requiring valuation evidence
reach.learn: Keep valuation opinion distinct from legal conclusions

evidence.claim: Native indexes and fixed preparation headings can remove repeated navigation and formatting; the local amounts are unmeasured.

assumptions: The appraiser already uses written testimony preparation notes. No new witness report, court filing or post-hearing log is introduced; the court's transcript is not appraiser labour.
The appraiser selects valuation revision, sources and relevant limitations in s1-s2, with capture and review counted. Missing evidence is investigated manually before testimony.
The index removes 2.5 of 25 navigation hours; note headings remove 2 of 20 structure-writing hours. Substantive preparation and all live testimony remain human.
Ordinary author saves have no self-approval gate. No source citation or fact is generated automatically.
unknowns: Whether preparation notes already use the proposed headings
research_questions: Do native index and heading changes remove actual preparation work without affecting evidential review?

already_counted.description: Prepare the actual explanation and deliver testimony

incremental.description: Maintain source-index links as workpaper structure changes

approvals.approved_version: Exact statements made about the identified property and valuation revision; each new question requires a fresh evidential judgement before answering

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 central B=100, R=95.5, gross 4.5 less 1 upkeep gives 3.5 net. Conservative case: index links are incomplete and notes already use headings, leaving only one navigation hour removable, offset by one upkeep hour. With compatible workpaper metadata removing two search hours and reusable headings removing one writing hour, 97 hours remain and 1 upkeep gives 2 net. All testimony time remains retained.

steps.what: Retrieve ownership records for each piece of taxable property
Identify ownership by resolving parcel, name and effective-date discrepancies
Write ownership identity and source references in the existing assessment workpaper
Check the ownership workpaper against source identity and dates

tasks.design: Use native parcel search and reusable workpaper fields in {OTHER}, the existing property-assessment application. The assessor resolves ownership and writes and checks the internal identification; no legal register amendment or notice send is implied.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated source navigation and stable parcel-reference entry consume identification work.
tasks.enabler_now: Native search views and reusable workpaper structure can remove these operations without determining disputed ownership automatically.
tasks.still_hard: Transfers, effective dates, names and parcel changes may conflict.
tasks.human_edge: Recognise when the evidence is insufficient to identify the relevant owner.
tasks.altitude: Reduce repeated record handling while retaining identity resolution.

reach.learn: Preserve effective dates and unresolved discrepancies

evidence.claim: Native parcel views and reusable workpaper fields can remove navigation and stable reference repetition; effects are unmeasured.

assumptions: The ownership workpaper already supports assessment. It is separate from a legal ownership register and does not create or change property rights.

The assessor produces parcel identifier, owner identity, effective date and source reference in s1-s3, with capture and resolution counted. Missing or inconsistent sources require manual investigation.

Search views remove 5 of 25 navigation hours. Reused stable parcel and source-label fields remove 12 of 30 workpaper-entry hours; actual owner details, qualifications and checks stay manual. No unattended field fill is implied.
Ordinary same-system author saves remain fully retained without an approval gate. No notice or external send is added.
research_questions: Can native field reuse remove the specified repetition without hiding unresolved owner identities?

already_counted.description: Record ownership evidence and check the completed identification

incremental.description: Maintain source views and workpaper field compatibility

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 central B=100, R=83, gross 17 less 2 upkeep gives 15 net. Conservative case: poor parcel metadata retains all 25 search hours and an existing form leaves only two entry hours removable, offset by two upkeep hours. Compatible source identities could retain 22 search and 22 entry hours plus other 45 and 2 upkeep, giving 9 net. Ownership resolution and final checking remain fully retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Collect current parcel, structure, characteristic and exemption evidence
Resolve effective dates, property characteristics and applicable exemption evidence
Update boundary maps from the resolved parcel evidence
Maintain inventories, characteristics and exemptions in the existing parcel record
Check record currency, map linkage and supporting exemption references

tasks.design: Use native source views in {DOCS} and current-parcel forms in {OTHER}, the property assessment and linked mapping application. The assessor resolves evidence, updates geometry separately and writes the actual inventory and exemption changes before checking the record.
tasks.previous_blocker: Source navigation and repeated stable parcel fields consume maintenance time.
tasks.enabler_now: Native views and existing record forms can reuse stable information without deciding exemptions or boundary geometry.
tasks.still_hard: Source changes may conflict and exemption applicability requires substantive review.
tasks.human_edge: Recognise which changes are supported and which need investigation.
tasks.altitude: Reduce repeated parcel entry while preserving data interpretation.

reach.learn: Keep geometry revisions aligned with effective record dates

evidence.claim: Native parcel forms and source views can remove stable-field repetition without automatically determining geometry or exemptions.

assumptions: All named parcel data and boundary-map work are included. The maintained assessment record is the existing output; no extra update log or publication send is added.

The assessor produces parcel ID, source revision, effective date, structure changes, characteristic values and exemption evidence in s1-s2, with capture counted. Missing or disputed evidence stays manual and is not inferred from old fields.

Source views remove 3 of 25 navigation hours. Current-parcel form reuse removes 12 of 30 repeated stable-identity and structure-entry hours; actual changed values and exemption rationale remain entered by the assessor. No machine import is implied.
Ordinary saves of the author's same-system record and map edits remain retained without a self-approval. Ownership work shared with 21555 is allocated once.
unknowns: Compatibility of map and assessment revision identifiers
research_questions: Do native forms remove repeated unchanged fields while preserving all actual parcel changes and their sources?

already_counted.description: Write actual parcel changes and check record and map consistency

incremental.description: Maintain parcel-form compatibility and source views

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 central B=100, R=85, gross 15 less 2 upkeep gives 13 net. Conservative case: inconsistent revision metadata retains all 25 collection hours and current forms leave only two stable-field hours removable, offset by two upkeep hours. Compatible record revisions could retain 23 collection and 22 entry hours plus other 45 and 2 upkeep, giving 8 net. Geometry, evidence resolution and final checks remain fully retained.

tasks.short: Establish uniform and equitable property assessment systems

steps.what: Review assessment outcomes and differences across property classes
Determine uniform methods and equitable treatment of property classes
Write the assessment methods, exceptions and rationale
Configure the chosen methods in the assessment system's test environment
Test class coverage and examine inequitable or inconsistent outcomes
Apply the tested assessment configuration to the operating system

tasks.design: Reuse specification structure in {DOCS} and compatible configuration profiles in {OTHER}, the existing assessment application. The assessor defines and tests the methods, then explicitly applies the exact tested configuration to the operating system.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated specification structure and stable configuration settings consume system-establishment time.
tasks.enabler_now: Native templates and reusable profiles can remove these operations without judging equity automatically.
tasks.still_hard: Uniform rules may still produce inequitable outcomes across different property classes.
tasks.human_edge: Judge whether consistent methods are appropriate and equitable in their actual effects.
tasks.altitude: Reduce repeated specification and setup work while retaining assessment-system judgement.

reach.learn: Test representative classes and explain exceptions

evidence.claim: Native specification templates and compatible configuration profiles can remove repeated setup without establishing equity by themselves.

assumptions: The written system specification and operational configuration are existing task outputs, not added approval records. No new policy board or public notice is invented.

The assessor produces class definitions, chosen methods, parameters, exceptions and representative test cases in s1-s4, with capture counted. Missing classes or unsupported parameters require manual specification and testing.

Specification headings remove 2 of 20 writing hours. Compatible profiles remove 3 of 15 stable setting-entry hours; unique method configuration and all testing remain. These are independently sized operations.
The s6 gate controls a real operating-system change, not a same-system save of the author's draft. Deployment time stays fully retained.
research_questions: Can reused profiles preserve specified class treatment and expose exceptions across independently checked cases?

already_counted.description: Test the candidate system and apply the selected operating version

incremental.description: Maintain compatible profiles and specification templates

approvals.approved_version: Exact tested configuration, class coverage, method parameters and operating target; any change requires rechecking before application

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 central B=100, R=95, gross 5 less 2 upkeep gives 3 net. Conservative case: layer and profile incompatibility prevents setting reuse while only two specification hours are removable, offset by two upkeep hours. With partially reusable specifications removing 1.5 writing hours and compatible settings removing 2 configuration hours, 96.5 hours remain and 2 upkeep gives 1.5 net. Equity judgement, tests and operating deployment remain fully retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional
